description: This source file defines the LuceneRecipeEventHandler class, which implements IRecipeEventHandler to provide backward compatibility for ContentIndexSettings migration to LuceneContentIndexSettings within OrchardCore content management system. It handles recipe step execution events to modify content type and part settings related to indexing.

classes.name: LuceneRecipeEventHandler
classes.description: Handles recipe events to ensure backward compatibility for content index settings, modifying content type and part definitions during recipe execution.

classes.name: ContentDefinitionStepModel
classes.description: Represents the model for a recipe step involving content definitions, including content types and parts.

methods.name: RecipeStepExecutedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the event after a recipe step has been executed; currently a no-op.

methods.name: ExecutionFailedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the event when recipe execution fails; currently a no-op.

methods.name: RecipeExecutedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the event after a recipe has been successfully executed; currently a no-op.

methods.name: RecipeExecutingAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the event before a recipe starts executing; currently a no-op.

methods.name: RecipeStepExecutingAsync
methods.description: Handles the recipe step execution event, modifies content type and part settings for backward compatibility during specific steps.
